# Keyboard shortcuts

<!-- Generated from src/shared/shortcuts.ts by `npm run docs:shortcuts`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Press `?` anywhere to see this list in the app, with a search box. Single-key shortcuts work when
you aren't typing in a field and no dialog is open.

## Anywhere

- `Ctrl` + `K`: Command palette and search
- `Ctrl` + `N`: Quick add, in the current project if there is one
- `Ctrl` + `Shift` + `N`: Quick add from anywhere
- `Ctrl` + `,`: Settings
- `Ctrl` + `B`: Collapse or expand the sidebar
- `G` then `H`: Go to Home
- `G` then `I`: Go to Inbox
- `G` then `M`: Go to My work
- `/`: Focus the view's search or filter
- `?`: Show keyboard shortcuts
- `Ctrl` + `Z`: Undo your last change (a text field undoes its typing)
- `Ctrl` + `Y`: Redo the last change you undid
- `G` then `U`: Open the undo history
- `Esc`: Close the top layer, then clear the selection
- `Ctrl` + `=`: Zoom in
- `Ctrl` + `-`: Zoom out
- `Ctrl` + `0`: Reset zoom

## In a project

- `Ctrl` + `1–9`: Project views, in order
- `Ctrl` + `H`: Find and replace in the current project

## Board and List

- `J`: Move between tasks
- `Enter`: Open the focused task
- `Alt` + `Shift` + `→`: Make a row in a plan a subtask of the row above
- `Alt` + `Shift` + `←`: Move a row in a plan up a level
- `Alt` + `Up` or `Down`: Move the focused task up or down, in Manual order (Board, List, a task's subtasks)
- `Alt` + `Left` or `Right`: Move the focused card to the previous or next column, in Manual order (Board)
- `Shift` + `Up` or `Down`: Move the focused card up or down a box, changing its priority (Matrix)
- `X`: Select or deselect the focused task
- `E`: Edit the title inline
- `Delete`: Move to the recycle bin

## Calendar and Timeline

- `T`: Go to today
- `Alt` + `Arrow keys`: Move the focused task a day (Left, Right) or a week (Up, Down) (Calendar); a day (Timeline)
- `Alt` + `Shift` + `Left` or `Right`: Move the focused task's due date a day (Timeline)
- `Alt` + `Ctrl` + `Left` or `Right`: Move the focused task's start date a day (Timeline)

## Library

- `Ctrl` + `F`: Search the Library
- `Ctrl` + `Shift` + `K`: Make a task from the selected lines (Library editor)

## Marking up a picture

- `V`: Select, to move and change marks
- `A`: Arrow
- `R`: Box
- `H`: Highlight
- `T`: Text
- `B`: Blur, for anything private
- `Ctrl` + `Z`: Undo
- `Ctrl` + `Y`: Redo
- `Tab`: Move to the next mark
- `Arrow keys`: Move the selected mark
- `Shift` + `Arrow keys`: Move the selected mark further
- `Alt` + `Arrow keys`: Resize the selected mark
- `Delete`: Delete the selected mark

## Whiteboards

- `V`: Select
- `H`: Hand: move around the whiteboard
- `Space` + `drag`: Move around the whiteboard with any tool
- `Tab`: Next object
- `Shift` + `Tab`: Previous object
- `Arrow keys`: Move the selection
- `Shift` + `Arrow keys`: Move the selection 10 times as far
- `Alt` + `Arrow keys`: Resize the selected object
- `Shift` + `Alt` + `Arrow keys`: Resize 10 times as far
- `Alt` + `drag`: Move without snapping to the grid
- `Shift` + `drag`: Resize and keep the shape
- `Ctrl` + `A`: Select everything
- `Escape`: Select nothing
- `Shift` + `F10`: Open the menu for the selection
- `Delete`: Delete the selection
- `Ctrl` + `Z`: Undo
- `Ctrl` + `Y`: Redo
- `+`: Zoom in
- `-`: Zoom out
- `Shift` + `1`: Fit the whole whiteboard
- `Shift` + `0`: Zoom to 100%
- `N`: Sticky note
- `T`: Text
- `Enter`: Place the chosen tool's object in the middle of the view
- `Enter`: Edit the selected object's text
- `Ctrl` + `Enter`: Finish editing text
- `Ctrl` + `D`: Duplicate
- `Ctrl` + `C`: Copy
- `Ctrl` + `X`: Cut
- `Ctrl` + `V`: Paste
- `Ctrl` + `G`: Group
- `Ctrl` + `Shift` + `G`: Ungroup
- `Ctrl` + `click`: Pick one object inside a group
- `Ctrl` + `]`: Bring forward
- `Ctrl` + `[`: Send backward
- `Ctrl` + `Shift` + `]`: Bring to front
- `Ctrl` + `Shift` + `[`: Send to back
- `P`: Pen
- `M`: Marker
- `E`: Eraser: rub out drawings
- `S`: Shape; press again for the next shape
- `F`: Frame
- `Shift` + `drag`: Draw a square or a circle
- `A`: Line or arrow
- `J`: Node: join objects at the middle of their sides
- `C`: Connect the selected object to another
- `I`: Insert a picture
- `Ctrl` + `Shift` + `V`: Paste each line as its own note
- `L`: Link to an item or web page
- `O`: Open the selected object’s link
- `K`: Make tasks from the selection
- `B`: Mind map
- `Tab` or `Insert`: Add a child idea (Tab while typing, Insert when selected)
- `Enter`: Add the next idea (while typing)
- `Shift` + `Enter`: New line in an idea
- `Arrow keys`: Move along a mind map’s branches
- `Shift` + `Arrow keys`: Move an idea and its branch (the central idea moves the whole map)

## From any app

These keys work while you are in another app, once you turn them on in Settings › General.
Both start off, and you choose the keys.

- **Quick add from anywhere** (`Ctrl` + `Alt` + `N` suggested): opens quick add
- **Snip to task** (`Ctrl` + `Alt` + `S` suggested): drag a rectangle on the screen, and quick
  add opens with the picture. `Enter` takes the whole screen; `Esc` or a right click cancels

Tooltips in the app show the same keys. In menus, the keys for an item are shown on its right.
